versions.changelog:
- Expanded from 41 to 60 built-in tools, greatly increasing coverage.
- Added support for deep patent research: claims, legal status, family, citations, figures, and translations.
- Introduced new capabilities in image recognition, PDF file analysis, and web content extraction.
- Enhanced description to reflect all newly supported features and applications.

- Added a homepage link (https://agent.linkfox.com/) to the skill metadata.
- No other functional or documentation changes detected.

linkfoxagent 1.0.8 changelog:

- Improved task invocation security: all calls to linkfox.py now use heredoc with stdin to avoid shell injection risks.
- Updated all example commands and templates to demonstrate the new --stdin heredoc pattern for safer prompt handling.
- No changes to functionality or toolset; core behavior remains the same.

- Added support and documentation for AI product image generation.
- Expanded built-in tools from 41 to 42, including new AI image generation capabilities.
- Updated and clarified user instructions for error handling, task submission, and CSV/report sharing.
- Improved sessions_spawn templates for both single and parallel tasks, with detailed messaging and post-processing guidance.
- Enhanced metadata structure for environment variable requirements.
- Updated tool and usage descriptions to reflect new features and workflow changes.

**Sessions must now be spawned for every task to ensure responsiveness.**

- Added mandatory instructions to dispatch all LinkFoxAgent tasks via sessions_spawn sub-agents, not in the main session.
- Updated usage and task examples to reflect this requirement, including YAML/command templates.
- Provided clearer guidance for dispatching multiple tasks in parallel using sub-agents.
- Main session now remains responsive; results are delivered automatically when sub-agent tasks complete.
- No changes to the underlying tool list or core functionality.

Version 1.0.3

- Added tool selection priority guidelines for Amazon product data, aggregation, and web parsing.
- Clarified recommended tool ordering when no tool is specified, prioritizing efficiency and data freshness.
- Updated documentation to explain tool selection logic for querying, statistics, and remote browser extraction.
- No changes to functionality or toolset.

Initial release of LinkFoxAgent – a powerful cross-border e-commerce AI agent with 41 integrated tools.

- Supports product research, competitor analysis, keyword tracking, review insights, patent/trademark/copyright detection, trend analysis, and 1688 sourcing.
- Provides multi-step prompt chaining, data aggregation, and report generation across Amazon, TikTok, eBay, Walmart, and 1688 platforms.
- Custom API key configuration for secure access.
- Includes detailed tool invocation syntax with parameter constraints and reference guides.
- Offers background task processing and flexible polling options for long-running tasks.
